Overview

About NAIFF Loan Scheme

The Agriculture Infrastructure Fund is a central sector financing facility for building post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets. It provides medium to long-term debt through banks, NBFCs and cooperative lenders.

Eligible projects receive a 3% per annum interest subvention on loans up to ₹2 Crore for a maximum of 7 years, plus credit guarantee cover under CGTMSE with the guarantee fee paid by the government. Projects include cold storage, warehouses, pack houses, sorting and grading units, processing units and other agri infrastructure.

Key benefits

  • Loans of up to ₹2 Crore per project, with multiple projects allowed at different locations
  • 3% per annum interest subvention for up to 7 years
  • CGTMSE credit guarantee cover, so no collateral is required
  • Flexible usage across post-harvest, processing and farm-gate infrastructure
  • Backed by a government scheme with transparent online approval

Who is eligible

  • Agri-startups and agri-MSMEs
  • Individual farmers and agri-entrepreneurs
  • FPOs, SHGs, cooperatives, JLGs and APMC-registered entities
  • Good repayment capacity and credit score
  • Compliance with the lending bank's appraisal guidelines

Documents required

  • KYC of the applicant or entity and registration documents
  • Detailed project report with cost estimates and quotations
  • Land ownership or lease documents for the project site
  • Bank statements, ITR and financials
  • Registration under Udyam, FPO, APMC or cooperative laws as applicable
